title: Creator & Personal Brand
subtitle: Grow an audience, make standout content and turn attention into sustainable income
description:
This path is for creators who want to treat their work like a business. You begin by defining a personal brand people remember, then learn the formats that grow audiences today: short-form video, YouTube and podcasts, with AI tools for video, voice and editing that save hours each week. Design fundamentals and brand identity help your content look consistent and professional across every platform.

The final courses cover how you earn: brand partnerships and influencer campaigns handled professionally, affiliate and discount-code sales with proper disclosure, and running a freelance or agency business around your skills. Every course is free, practical and ends with a certificate you can show brands and clients.
outcomes: Define a clear personal brand and content pillars
Plan, film and edit short-form and long-form video that holds attention
Use AI video and voice tools to publish more without lowering quality
Work with brands professionally, with correct advertising disclosure
Build income from affiliates, partnerships and client services
audience: New and growing creators and influencers
Professionals who want a personal brand alongside their job
